title: cargo-allow tool identity v1
description: Self-description contract emitted by `cargo-allow tool identity`. This is NOT a governed artifact: it does not carry claim_boundary, scanner_limitations, or inventory fields. It describes the binary's build provenance and supported protocol generations for compatibility checking.

executable_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the cargo-allow executable, prefixed with 'sha256:'.

reported_version.description: Package version from CARGO_PKG_VERSION at build time.

build_source_commit.description: Git commit hash the binary was built from, if recorded at build time via CARGO_ALLOW_BUILD_COMMIT.

compiler_identity.description: Rust compiler identity string, if recorded at build time via CARGO_ALLOW_RUSTC_IDENTITY.

profile.description: Build profile (e.g. 'release', 'debug'), if recorded at build time.

command_api_generation.description: Command API generation identifier for CLI compatibility checking.

supported_profile_generations.description: Profile generations this binary can evaluate.

supported_schema_generations.description: Schema generations this binary can produce or validate.

supported_result_generations.description: Precommit result generations this binary can emit.

supported_receipt_generations.description: Receipt generations this binary can produce.

channel.description: Distribution channel: PublishedRelease for crates.io/published binaries, SourcePreview for local builds.
